name: @sammons/typed-mind-python
description: Python analysis and bridge to TypedMind DSL - extract architecture from Python codebases
author: sammons

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && tsc --build && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @sammons/typed-mind run build && pnpm run build:wasm
scripts.guard:npm-publish: node -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('publish with pnpm, not npm (workspace:* would ship verbatim)'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('publish with pnpm, not npm (workspace:* would ship verbatim)'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm test
